title: Truck Route Planner EU
shortDescription: EU driving breaks, tolls and national rules for your truck trips across Europe.
fullDescription:
Truck Route Planner turns two addresses into a complete trip plan for heavy goods vehicles in Europe.

NOT A GOVERNMENT APP: this is an independent app. It does not represent, and is not affiliated with, the European Union or any government or public authority. The rules it summarises come from the official sources listed at the end of this description.

• Driving times and breaks: works out the 45-minute breaks and the daily rests under Regulation (EC) No 561/2006, with the permitted alternatives, such as the split break or the reduced daily rest.
• Stop plan: the time and kilometre of every mandatory break and rest.
• Team driving: planning for one or two drivers.
• Estimated tolls per country, based on the vehicle's weight, axles and EURO class.
• Fuel and total trip cost, also per kilometre.
• National rules for each country on the route: driving bans, low-emission zones and winter equipment.
• Route map with the stops, to view or save.
• Break reminders: your phone alerts you before each mandatory break of the trip.
• Use my location as the starting point.
• Text report and GPX export.
• Available in all 24 official EU languages.

No accounts, no ads and no selling of data.

Important: the results are estimates for planning and are not legally binding. Always check the traffic restrictions, toll rates and vehicle limits in force at the official sources below, as well as your actual tachograph records.

OFFICIAL SOURCES
• Driving times, breaks and rest periods – Regulation (EC) No 561/2006 (EUR-Lex): https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2006/561/oj
• Driving time and rest periods – European Commission: https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-modes/road/social-provisions/driving-time-and-rest-periods_en
• Tolls and vignettes – European Commission, road charging: https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-modes/road/road-charging_en
• Low-emission zones – European Commission, urban vehicle access regulations: https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/urban-transport/urban-vehicle-access-regulations_en
• Road rules and winter equipment by country – Your Europe, official EU website: https://europa.eu/youreurope/citizens/travel/driving-abroad/road-rules-and-safety/index_en.htm
• Truck driving bans and official toll operators, country by country: https://chispapps.com/truckrouteplanner/sources.html
releaseNotes: First release: truck routes with breaks and rests under Regulation (EC) 561/2006, estimated tolls per country, national rules, map, break reminders and 24 languages.
